telemetry.node_cpu_ram_network: Collected counters; not converted into per-worker demand or rates

limitations: Only one prefill role; no router/decode/cross-node transfer or real output IDs.
Native health may execute an internal one-token forward; no user benchmark workload was sent.
Only launcher mask captured; actual scheduler/rank/thread NUMA mapping not collected.
Startup samples do not describe scored utilization, latency or critical path.
Post-readiness SIGTERM and detokenizer -15/SIGQUIT are from the driver cleanup; preserved, not silently treated as startup failures.
Different physical node than 222780; this is a validated configuration repair, not a matched causal speedup study.
